# BSPrep

> BSPrep is an independent, student-led platform that helps IITM BS (IIT Madras BS Degree) students prepare. It offers Tamil-medium video courses, live mentor classes, GPA calculation tools, a free online compiler, community study notes, past-paper quiz practice with OPPE mock tests, and a public doubts library. BSPrep is not affiliated with or endorsed by IIT Madras.

BSPrep is built by students for students and is based in India. Courses are taught mainly in Tamil. The Qualifier and Foundation levels are available today. Enrollments may be closed at times, so check the course page for the current status.

## Courses

- [All courses](https://bsprep.in/courses): Catalog of Tamil video courses for the IITM BS Qualifier and Foundation levels
- [Mathematics for Data Science I](https://bsprep.in/courses/qualifier-math-1): 4-week Qualifier course on sets, functions, straight lines, quadratics and polynomials
- [Statistics for Data Science I](https://bsprep.in/courses/qualifier-stats-1): 4-week Qualifier course on data types, descriptive statistics and association between variables
- [Computational Thinking](https://bsprep.in/courses/qualifier-computational-thinking): 4-week Qualifier course on flowcharts, pseudocode, iteration and filtering
- [English I](https://bsprep.in/courses/qualifier-english-1): 4-week Qualifier course on sounds, parts of speech, sentences and speaking skills
- [Programming in Python](https://bsprep.in/courses/qualifier-python): 4-week Qualifier course that teaches Python from scratch
- [Programming in Java](https://bsprep.in/courses/qualifier-java): 4-week Qualifier course on Java and object oriented programming
- [Statistics for Data Science II](https://bsprep.in/courses/foundation-stats-2): Foundation course on distributions, estimation, hypothesis testing and regression
- [Qualifier Bundle](https://bsprep.in/courses/qualifier-bundle): All four Qualifier courses together at a discount
- [Coding Bundle](https://bsprep.in/courses/coding-bundle): Python and Java together at a discount

## Tools

- [GPA calculator](https://bsprep.in/tools/gpa-calculator): Calculate your course grade and semester GPA for IITM BS courses
- [GPA predictor](https://bsprep.in/tools/gpa-predictor): Find the exam score you need for a target grade
- [Online compiler](https://bsprep.in/compiler): Free in-browser compiler for Python, Java, C and C++ with a multi-file editor and share links

## Practice

- [Quiz prep](https://bsprep.in/quiz-prep): Timed mock tests, quick tests and custom tests from past IITM BS quiz and end term papers, plus OPPE coding practice

## Learn and community

- [Notes](https://bsprep.in/resources): Free community notes for Foundation, Diploma and Degree subjects, with download counts and a contributor leaderboard
- [Doubts](https://bsprep.in/doubts): Public library of verified doubts with answers from mentors and peers
- [Community](https://bsprep.in/community): Tamil-speaking IITM BS student community, with links to WhatsApp, YouTube, LinkedIn and the blog
- [Blog](https://blog.bsprep.in): Guides for IITM BS students

## Company and policies

- [Careers](https://bsprep.in/careers): Open roles and internships on the BSPrep team
- [Privacy policy](https://bsprep.in/privacy): How BSPrep handles personal data
- [Terms and conditions](https://bsprep.in/terms): Terms of using the platform
- [Refund policy](https://bsprep.in/refund-policy): Payments and refunds are handled through Razorpay only
- [Cookie policy](https://bsprep.in/cookies): Cookies and analytics used on the site
- [Disclaimer](https://bsprep.in/disclaimer): Independence from IIT Madras and no guarantee of results
